notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling cards from your graveyard equal to the number of opponent you have, giving Mirror-Mad Phantasm encore until end of turn.
Activate Mirror-Mad Phantasm's encore ability by paying {3}{U}{U} and exiling it, causing you to create a token copy with haste for each opponent you have.
Activate a Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, causing you to shuffle it into your library, then reveal and mill your entire library due to not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.
